content_blocks.text: The photo is done. The sentence is not.

content_blocks.content:
When we build products for early childhood centres, classroom time is the scarce resource. Teachers already capture meals, naps, and learning moments in Clayox. The slow part is writing a parent-facing update that matches the photo, sounds like the centre, and does not invent details.

That is the job Write with AI is built for: a first draft from a short note, up to four photos, or both. The draft prefills the activity form. Staff still review and post. Nothing reaches the parent feed until a person taps Post.

content_blocks.text: What Write with AI actually drafts

content_blocks.content:
For activities, Write with AI can suggest type, title, and notes from the teacher's description and from what is clearly visible in attached photos. Mood and meal amount fill only when the note or photo clearly supports them.

Staff can also draft a progress summary from their own observations: title, summary, strengths, and next focus. Parents see that summary only after Publish. Write with AI also drafts internal staff notes, direct messages, and broadcasts. Parents never see the Write with AI button.

We designed hard boundaries so centres can trust the product:

  • It does not auto-post, auto-publish, or auto-send.
  • It does not scan the week's activity feed, attendance, or photo history to invent a progress report.
  • It does not invent scenes, skills, diagnoses, or names that were not in the note or photos.
  • It is not an assessment framework, structured learning journal, or photo-tagging product.

If a vendor claims AI analyses every day's activities into a termly report, ask what data is actually used to write that draft. In Clayox, progress drafts start from what the teacher types.

content_blocks.text: How this sits next to translation and enquiries

content_blocks.content:
AI translation is for enrolled families and staff who want to read an existing update in another language. Write with AI is for staff who need a first English draft. Both use the same server-side AI stack on each centre's dedicated deployment. The optional AI enquiry assistant is separate: it captures conversations from prospective families, and your team still decides what becomes a lead.

Product details live on clayox.com/ai-write-childcare-updates. For rollout with your classrooms, book a free consultation with IGENTX, or start from the Clayox product page.
